Original private data and environment settings unchanged.

Supplemental review found corrupt resumable Bun cache lockout. Exact shell branch now discards checksum/HTTP22 failures and permits at most two fetches, preserves interrupted transfer bytes and mandates final pin hash. RUN098 red and099 green include five mocked branches. Old DB policy oracle now verifies all0001/0002/0003 SQL bytes and hashes; RUN096 failure preserved.

Supplemental cache review extends non-resumable recovery to curl22/33/36; strict retry mock requires absent partial. RUN100 red and101 seven-branch green preserve timeout resume and repeated-corruption refusal.

All failed/interrupted attempts retained.
